summary: Backend-only testing of DACTE autonomous crypto trading bot. Created pytest suite covering all 20+ endpoints per review request. 25/25 tests PASSED. Verified telemetry (state/config/connection/account/positions/orders/events/feed/decisions/news/scanner/analysis), mode transitions (off/spot/futures + invalid rejection), live-trading confirm gating (wrong=400, correct=200), resume safety gate (400 when mode=off or live=false), config persistence via PUT, emergency close/cancel with confirm gating, and backtest historical simulation (BTCUSD 15m 300 candles). Delta signed auth is working end-to-end (account=LIVE, rest/ws_public/ws_private/market_data/news all CONNECTED/LIVE, required_ip=null). Safety verified at end: mode=off, live_trading=false, status=PAUSED. No real orders placed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /bot/live accepts enabled=false without any confirmation and returns 200 — intentional for safety-off shortcut, but consider logging.
backtest strategy is a simple EMA 9/21 crossover and does not reflect the live decision engine; label already discloses HISTORICAL SIMULATION, acceptable.
analysis endpoint response schema is not versioned; downstream frontend should tolerate additional keys.
seed_data_creation: None. Only mutated config (min_confidence=70, technical weight=30) via PUT which persists in DB — main agent may want to reset if defaults are required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 25 backend tests pass. Bot left safely: mode=off, live_trading=false, PAUSED. Delta account was LIVE (auth working, required_ip=null).
